blocks.text: Unexpected expenses rarely wait for payday. A medical bill, home repair, school expense, or temporary cash-flow gap can leave Filipinos looking for a quick source of funds. For qualified SSS members, SSS LoanLite powered by RCBC DiskarTech offers a digital option for short-term financial needs. Eligible members can apply through the RCBC DiskarTech app without visiting a branch or going through a lengthy application process. Small loan, digital convenience Qualified members can borrow ₱1,000 to ₱20,000, with repayment terms of 60 or 90 days, subject to SSS eligibility, applicable rates, fees, and charges.
